## Page Or Section

## Safety Check

- [ ] The fix keeps TKEN disclosed as one example endpoint, not a required dependency.
- [ ] The fix avoids unsupported price, performance, availability, partnership, usage-capacity, or outcome-certainty claims.
- [ ] The fix does not include API keys, account identifiers, private logs, or screenshots containing secrets.
